void emit(string text)
    println(text)

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

int gcd(int first, int second)
    a := absolute(first)
    b := absolute(second)
    while b != 0
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

string decimal(int value, nat places)
    scale := 1
    for: i < places
        scale *= 10
    fraction := string(absolute(value) % scale)
    return (if value < 0 then "-" else "") + string(absolute(value) / scale) + "." + "0" * (places - #fraction) + fraction

string signed(int value)
    return (if value > 0 then "+" else "") + string(value)

bool digits(string text)
    if text == ""
        return false
    for: i < #text
        if not "0123456789".contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

int locate(string[] items, string item)
    for: i < #items
        if items[i] == item
            return int(i)
    return -1

string[] symbols()
    return "H He Li Be B C N O F Ne Na Mg Al Si P S Cl Ar K Ca Sc Ti V Cr Mn Fe Co Ni Cu Zn Ga Ge As Se Br Kr Rb Sr Y Zr Nb Mo Tc Ru Rh Pd Ag Cd In Sn Sb Te I Xe".split(" ")

int[] weights()
    return [1008, 4003, 6941, 9012, 10811, 12011, 14007, 15999, 18998, 20180, 22990, 24305, 26982, 28086, 30974, 32065, 35453, 39948, 39098, 40078, 44956, 47867, 50942, 51996, 54938, 55845, 58933, 58693, 63546, 65380, 69723, 72630, 74922, 78971, 79904, 83798, 85468, 87620, 88906, 91224, 92906, 95950, 98000, 101070, 102906, 106420, 107868, 112414, 114818, 118710, 121760, 127600, 126904, 131293]

int[] hill_order(int[] counts)
    names := symbols()
    present := [for i := (nat(0):<#names)[] if counts[i] > 0 then names[i]]
    ordered := present.sorted()
    if counts[5] > 0
        ordered = ["C"].concat(if counts[0] > 0 then ["H"] else []).concat([for name := ordered[] if name != "C" and name != "H" then name])
    return [for name := ordered[] then locate(names, name)]

string hill(int[] counts, charge := 0)
    result := ""
    names := symbols()
    for element := hill_order(counts)[]
        result += names[element] + (if counts[element] == 1 then "" else string(counts[element]))
    if charge != 0
        result += "^" + (if absolute(charge) == 1 then "" else string(absolute(charge))) + (if charge > 0 then "+" else "-")
    return result

class Fraction(int numerator, denominator := 1)
    local divisor := gcd(numerator, denominator)
    numerator /= divisor
    denominator /= divisor
    if denominator < 0
        numerator = -numerator
        denominator = -denominator

    Fraction plus(Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.denominator + other.numerator * denominator, denominator * other.denominator)

    Fraction minus(Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.denominator - other.numerator * denominator, denominator * other.denominator)

    Fraction times(Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.numerator, denominator * other.denominator)

    Fraction divided(Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.denominator, denominator * other.numerator)

    string notation()
        return signed(numerator) + (if denominator == 1 then "" else "/{denominator}")

class Formula(int[] counts, charge := 0)
    int mass()
        result := 0
        table := weights()
        for: i < #counts
            result += counts[i] * table[i]
        return result

class FormulaReader(string text)
    nat position := 0
    unknown := ""

    int | error .multiplier()
        begin := position
        while position < #text and "0123456789".contains(text[position])
            position += 1
        if position == begin
            return 1
        if text[begin] == "0"
            return error("syntax")
        return int(text[begin:<position])

    int[] | error .sequence()
        result := array(54, fill = 0)
        any_item := false
        while position < #text
            token := text[position]
            item := array(54, fill = 0)
            if "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".contains(token)
                position += 1
                if position < #text and "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(text[position])
                    token += text[position]
                    position += 1
                element := locate(symbols(), token)
                if element < 0
                    if unknown == ""
                        unknown = token
                else
                    item[element] = 1
            elif token == "(" or token == "["
                position += 1
                item = try .sequence()
                closing := if token == "(" then ")" else "]"
                if position >= #text or text[position] != closing
                    return error("syntax")
                position += 1
            else
                break
            any_item = true
            int factor := try .multiplier()
            for: nat i < 54
                result[i] += item[i] * factor
        if not any_item
            return error("syntax")
        return result

    Formula | error .parse()
        int[] result := try .sequence()
        while position < #text and text[position] == "."
            position += 1
            int factor := try .multiplier()
            int[] hydrate := try .sequence()
            for: nat i < 54
                result[i] += hydrate[i] * factor
        charge := 0
        if position < #text and text[position] == "^"
            position += 1
            charge = try .multiplier()
            if position >= #text or (text[position] != "+" and text[position] != "-")
                return error("syntax")
            if text[position] == "-"
                charge = -charge
            position += 1
        if position != #text
            return error("syntax")
        return Formula(result, charge)

Formula | error read_formula(string text, original := "")
    reader := FormulaReader(text)
    match .reader.parse()
        Formula parsed
            if reader.unknown != ""
                return error("unknown element " + reader.unknown)
            return parsed
        error failure
            return error("invalid formula " + (if original == "" then text else original))

int | error quantity(string word, enthalpy := false)
    text := word
    negative := enthalpy and text.starts_with("-")
    if negative
        text = text[1:]
    parts := text.split(".")
    nat precision := if enthalpy then 2 else 3
    nat max_integer := if enthalpy then 5 else 4
    valid := #parts >= 1 and #parts <= 2
    if valid
        valid = digits(parts[0]) and #parts[0] <= max_integer and (#parts[0] == 1 or parts[0][0] != "0")
    fraction := ""
    if #parts == 2
        fraction = parts[1]
        valid = valid and digits(fraction) and #fraction <= precision
    if not valid
        return error((if enthalpy then "invalid enthalpy " else "invalid quantity ") + word)
    scale := if enthalpy then 100 else 1000
    int value := int(parts[0]) * scale
    if fraction != ""
        value += int(fraction + "0" * (precision - #fraction))
    if not enthalpy and value == 0
        return error("invalid quantity " + word)
    return if negative then -value else value

class Species(string name, string core, string state, Formula formula, coefficient := 1)

Species | error read_species(string word, coefficients := false)
    text := word
    state := ""
    for suffix := ["(s)", "(l)", "(g)", "(aq)"][]
        if text.ends_with(suffix)
            state = suffix
            text = text[:<#text - #suffix]
            break
    coefficient := 1
    nat begin := 0
    if coefficients
        while begin < #text and "0123456789".contains(text[begin])
            begin += 1
        if begin > 0
            if text[0] == "0"
                return error("invalid formula " + word)
            coefficient = int(text[:<begin])
    text = text[begin:]
    formula := try read_formula(text, word)
    return Species(text + state, text, state, formula, coefficient)

class Equation(Species[] species, int reactants)

Equation | error read_equation(string[] words, coefficients := false)
    valid := #words % 2 == 1
    arrow := -1
    for: i < #words
        if i % 2 == 0
            if words[i] == "+" or words[i] == "->"
                valid = false
        elif words[i] == "->"
            if arrow >= 0
                valid = false
            arrow = int(i)
        elif words[i] != "+"
            valid = false
    if not valid or arrow < 0
        return error("malformed equation")
    Species[] species := []
    for: i < #words step 2
        item := try read_species(words[i], coefficients)
        species = species.append(item)
    return Equation(species, (arrow + 1) / 2)

class Matrix(string[] labels, int[][] entries, int rank, int[][] basis)

Matrix analyze(Species[] species, int[] signs)
    present := array(54, fill = 0)
    for item := species[]
        for: nat i < 54
            present[i] += item.formula.counts[i]
    elements := hill_order(present)
    names := symbols()
    labels := [for element := elements[] then names[element]].append("charge")
    int[][] entries := []
    for element := elements[]
        entries = entries.append([for j := (nat(0):<#species)[] then signs[j] * species[j].formula.counts[element]])
    entries = entries.append([for j := (nat(0):<#species)[] then signs[j] * species[j].formula.charge])
    reduced := [for row := entries[] then [for entry := row[] then Fraction(entry)]]
    int[] pivots := []
    int[] free := []
    nat rank := 0
    for: column < #species
        chosen := rank
        while chosen < #reduced and reduced[chosen][column].numerator == 0
            chosen += 1
        if chosen == #reduced
            free = free.append(int(column))
            continue
        saved := reduced[rank]
        reduced[rank] = reduced[chosen]
        reduced[chosen] = saved
        divisor := reduced[rank][column]
        for: j < #species
            reduced[rank][j] = reduced[rank][j].divided(divisor)
        for: i < #reduced
            if i == rank
                continue
            factor := reduced[i][column]
            for: j < #species
                reduced[i][j] = reduced[i][j].minus(factor.times(reduced[rank][j]))
        pivots = pivots.append(int(column))
        rank += 1
    int[][] basis := []
    for column := free[]
        vector := array(#species, fill = Fraction(0))
        vector[column] = Fraction(1)
        for: i < rank
            entry := reduced[i][column]
            vector[pivots[i]] = Fraction(-entry.numerator, entry.denominator)
        multiple := 1
        for entry := vector[]
            multiple = multiple / gcd(multiple, entry.denominator) * entry.denominator
        integers := [for entry := vector[] then entry.numerator * (multiple / entry.denominator)]
        divisor := 0
        for entry := integers[]
            divisor = gcd(divisor, entry)
        basis = basis.append([for entry := integers[] then entry / divisor])
    return Matrix(labels, entries, int(rank), basis)

int[] | string determine(Matrix matrix, nat required)
    if #matrix.basis == 0
        return "IMPOSSIBLE"
    if #matrix.basis > 1
        return "AMBIGUOUS (nullity {#matrix.basis})"
    coefficients := matrix.basis[0]
    if coefficients[0] < 0
        coefficients = [for value := coefficients[] then -value]
    for: i < required
        if coefficients[i] <= 0
            return "IMPOSSIBLE"
    return coefficients

string term(string name, int coefficient)
    return (if coefficient == 1 then "" else string(coefficient)) + name

string balanced(Equation equation, int[] coefficients)
    string[] left := []
    string[] right := []
    for: i < #equation.species
        text := term(equation.species[i].name, coefficients[i])
        if int(i) < equation.reactants
            left = left.append(text)
        else
            right = right.append(text)
    return left.join(" + ") + " -> " + right.join(" + ")

string[] ratio_report(int[] amounts)
    elements := hill_order(amounts)
    table := weights()
    names := symbols()
    smallest := elements[0]
    for element := elements[]
        if amounts[element] * table[smallest] < amounts[smallest] * table[element]
            smallest = element
    string[] output := []
    for element := elements[]
        output = output.append(names[element] + " " + decimal(1000 * amounts[element] * table[smallest] / (table[element] * amounts[smallest]), 3))
    for: 1 <= factor <= 12
        composition := array(54, fill = 0)
        valid := true
        for element := elements[]
            numerator := factor * amounts[element] * table[smallest]
            denominator := table[element] * amounts[smallest]
            rounded := (2 * numerator + denominator) / (2 * denominator)
            if 20 * absolute(numerator - rounded * denominator) > denominator
                valid = false
            composition[element] = rounded
        if valid
            return output.append(hill(composition) + " (k = {factor})")
    return output.append("no simple ratio")

string salt_part(string text, int count)
    core := text.split("^")[0]
    if count == 1
        return core
    simple := locate(symbols(), core) >= 0
    if core.starts_with("[")
        depth := 0
        for: i < #core
            if core[i] == "["
                depth += 1
            elif core[i] == "]"
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0
                    simple = i == #core - 1
                    break
    return (if simple then core else "(" + core + ")") + string(count)

string oxidation(Formula formula)
    order := hill_order(formula.counts)
    names := symbols()
    values := array(54, fill = Fraction(0))
    assigned := array(54, fill = false)
    last := -1
    fixed := ["Li", "Na", "K", "Rb", "Be", "Mg", "Ca", "Sr", "Al"]
    if #order == 1
        element := order[0]
        values[element] = Fraction(formula.charge, formula.counts[element])
    else
        int[] assignment_order := []
        if formula.counts[8] > 0
            assignment_order = assignment_order.append(8)
            values[8] = Fraction(-1)
        for element := order[]
            metal := locate(fixed, names[element])
            if metal >= 0
                assignment_order = assignment_order.append(element)
                values[element] = Fraction(if metal < 4 then 1 elif metal < 8 then 2 else 3)
        if formula.counts[0] > 0
            hydride := true
            for element := order[]
                if element != 0 and locate(fixed, names[element]) < 0
                    hydride = false
            assignment_order = assignment_order.append(0)
            values[0] = Fraction(if hydride then -1 else 1)
        if formula.counts[7] > 0
            assignment_order = assignment_order.append(7)
            values[7] = Fraction(-2)
        if formula.counts[7] == 0 and formula.counts[8] == 0
            for element := [16, 34, 52][]
                if formula.counts[element] > 0
                    assignment_order = assignment_order.append(element)
                    values[element] = Fraction(-1)
                    break
        sum := 0
        for element := assignment_order[]
            assigned[element] = true
            last = element
            sum += formula.counts[element] * values[element].numerator
        unknown := [for element := order[] if not assigned[element] then element]
        if #unknown >= 2
            return "indeterminate: " + [for element := unknown[] then names[element]].join(" ")
        if #unknown == 1
            element := unknown[0]
            values[element] = Fraction(formula.charge - sum, formula.counts[element])
        elif sum != formula.charge
            values[last] = Fraction(formula.charge - sum + formula.counts[last] * values[last].numerator, formula.counts[last])
    return [for element := order[] then names[element] + " " + values[element].notation()].join(", ")

class Calculator()
    heats := map<string, int>()

    string[] | error .execute(string[] words)
        command := words[0]
        args := words[1:]
        one := ["ELEMENT", "PARSE", "MASS", "PERCENT", "EMPIRICAL", "DBE", "OXSTATE"]
        two := ["MOLES", "GRAMS", "MOLECULAR", "SALT", "HEAT"]
        equation_commands := ["BALANCE", "MATRIX", "CHECK", "DELTAH"]
        special := locate(["COMBUST", "HEATS", "DERIVE", "REDOX", "HALF", "STOICH", "LIMITING", "YIELD"], command) >= 0
        if locate(one, command) < 0 and locate(two, command) < 0 and locate(equation_commands, command) < 0 and not special
            return error("unknown command " + command)
        wrong := (locate(one, command) >= 0 and #args != 1) or (locate(two, command) >= 0 and #args != 2) or (locate(equation_commands, command) >= 0 and #args == 0)
        wrong = wrong or (command == "COMBUST" and #args != 3) or (command == "HEATS" and #args != 0) or (command == "DERIVE" and (#args < 2 or #args % 2 != 0)) or ((command == "REDOX" or command == "HALF") and #args < 2)
        if wrong
            return error("wrong argument count for " + command)
        names := symbols()
        table := weights()
        if command == "ELEMENT"
            element := locate(names, args[0])
            if element < 0
                return error("unknown element " + args[0])
            return [args[0] + " (Z = {element + 1}) " + decimal(table[element], 3) + " u"]
        if command == "HEATS"
            keys := heats.keys().sorted()
            if #keys == 0
                return ["no enthalpies"]
            string[] output := []
            for key := keys[]
                match heats.get(key)
                    int value
                        output = output.append(key + " " + decimal(value, 2) + " kJ/mol")
                    none
                        void
            return output
        if command == "HEAT"
            species := try read_species(args[0])
            value := try quantity(args[1], true)
            output := "dHf(" + args[0] + ") = " + decimal(value, 2) + " kJ/mol"
            match heats.get(species.name)
                int previous
                    output += " (was " + decimal(previous, 2) + ")"
                none
                    void
            .heats.set(species.name, value)
            return [output]
        if command == "DERIVE" or command == "COMBUST"
            amounts := array(54, fill = 0)
            string[] output := []
            if command == "DERIVE"
                sum := 0
                for: i < #args step 2
                    element := locate(names, args[i])
                    if element < 0
                        return error("unknown element " + args[i])
                    if amounts[element] > 0
                        return error("duplicate element " + args[i])
                    value := try quantity(args[i + 1])
                    if value > 100000
                        return error("invalid percentage " + args[i + 1])
                    amounts[element] = value
                    sum += value
                if absolute(sum - 100000) > 1000
                    return error("percentages sum to " + decimal(sum, 3))
            else
                sample := try quantity(args[0])
                co2 := try quantity(args[1])
                water := try quantity(args[2])
                carbon := co2 * 12011 / 44009
                hydrogen := water * 2016 / 18015
                oxygen := sample - carbon - hydrogen
                if carbon == 0 or hydrogen == 0 or 100 * oxygen < -sample
                    return error("inconsistent masses")
                amounts[5] = carbon
                amounts[0] = hydrogen
                if 100 * oxygen > sample
                    amounts[7] = oxygen
                for element := [5, 0, 7][]
                    if amounts[element] > 0
                        output = output.append("mass " + names[element] + " " + decimal(amounts[element], 3) + " g")
            return output.concat(ratio_report(amounts))
        if locate(one, command) >= 0 or locate(["MOLES", "GRAMS", "MOLECULAR", "SALT"], command) >= 0
            formula := try read_formula(args[0])
            mass := formula.mass()
            order := hill_order(formula.counts)
            if command == "PARSE"
                return [hill(formula.counts, formula.charge) + " (" + [for element := order[] then names[element] + " {formula.counts[element]}"].join(", ") + "; charge " + signed(formula.charge) + ")"]
            if command == "MASS"
                return ["M(" + args[0] + ") = " + decimal(mass, 3) + " g/mol"]
            if command == "PERCENT"
                return [for element := order[] then names[element] + " " + decimal(10000 * formula.counts[element] * table[element] / mass, 2) + "%"]
            if command == "EMPIRICAL"
                divisor := 0
                for count := formula.counts[]
                    divisor = gcd(divisor, count)
                return [hill([for count := formula.counts[] then count / divisor]) + " (n = {divisor})"]
            if command == "OXSTATE"
                return [oxidation(formula)]
            if command == "DBE" or command == "MOLECULAR"
                if formula.charge != 0
                    return error("charged formula " + args[0])
            if command == "DBE"
                string[][] valences := [["H", "F", "Cl", "Br", "I"], ["O", "S", "Se"], ["B", "N", "P", "As"], ["C", "Si", "Ge"]]
                twice := 2
                for element := order[]
                    valence := 0
                    for: i < #valences
                        if locate(valences[i], names[element]) >= 0
                            valence = int(i) + 1
                    if valence == 0
                        return error("no valence for " + names[element])
                    twice += formula.counts[element] * (valence - 2)
                return ["DBE = " + (if twice < 0 then "-" else "") + string(absolute(twice) / 2) + (if absolute(twice) % 2 == 0 then ".0" else ".5")]
            if command == "SALT"
                anion := try read_formula(args[1])
                if formula.charge <= 0
                    return error("not a cation " + args[0])
                if anion.charge >= 0
                    return error("not an anion " + args[1])
                for argument := args[]
                    if argument.contains(".")
                        return error("hydrate ion " + argument)
                divisor := gcd(formula.charge, anion.charge)
                a := -anion.charge / divisor
                b := formula.charge / divisor
                composition := [for i := (nat(0):<54)[] then a * formula.counts[i] + b * anion.counts[i]]
                return [salt_part(args[0], a) + salt_part(args[1], b) + " (" + hill(composition) + ", " + decimal(a * mass + b * anion.mass(), 3) + " g/mol)"]
            amount := try quantity(args[1])
            if command == "MOLES"
                return [decimal(amount, 3) + " g " + args[0] + " = " + decimal(amount * 1000000 / mass, 6) + " mol"]
            if command == "GRAMS"
                return [decimal(amount, 3) + " mol " + args[0] + " = " + decimal(amount * mass / 1000, 3) + " g"]
            multiple := (2 * amount + mass) / (2 * mass)
            if multiple == 0 or 10 * absolute(amount - multiple * mass) > mass
                return ["no integer multiple (ratio " + decimal(1000 * amount / mass, 3) + ")"]
            return [hill([for count := formula.counts[] then count * multiple]) + " (n = {multiple}, " + decimal(multiple * mass, 3) + " g/mol)"]
        equation_words := args
        string[] trailing := []
        redox := command == "REDOX" or command == "HALF"
        if redox
            if args[0] != "acidic" and args[0] != "basic"
                return error("invalid medium " + args[0])
            equation_words = args[1:]
        if command == "STOICH" or command == "LIMITING" or command == "YIELD"
            separator := -1
            for: i < #args
                if args[i] == ":"
                    if separator >= 0
                        return error("invalid separator")
                    separator = int(i)
            if separator < 0
                return error("invalid separator")
            trailing = args[separator + 1:]
            equation_words = args[:<separator]
            if (command == "STOICH" and #trailing != 2) or (command == "YIELD" and #trailing != 4)
                return error("wrong argument count for " + command)
        equation := try read_equation(equation_words, command == "CHECK")
        species := equation.species
        signs := [for i := (nat(0):<#species)[] then (if int(i) < equation.reactants then 1 else -1)]
        first := -1
        second := -1
        int[] quantities := []
        int[] enthalpies := []
        if command == "STOICH"
            first = locate([for item := species[] then item.name], trailing[0])
            if first < 0
                return error("species " + trailing[0] + " not in equation")
            amount := try quantity(trailing[1])
            quantities = [amount]
        elif command == "LIMITING"
            if int(#trailing) != equation.reactants
                return error("expected {equation.reactants} masses, got {#trailing}")
            for word := trailing[]
                amount := try quantity(word)
                quantities = quantities.append(amount)
        elif command == "YIELD"
            first = locate([for item := species[:<equation.reactants][] then item.name], trailing[0])
            if first < 0
                return error(trailing[0] + " is not a reactant")
            second = locate([for item := species[equation.reactants:][] then item.name], trailing[2])
            if second < 0
                return error(trailing[2] + " is not a product")
            second += equation.reactants
            supplied := try quantity(trailing[1])
            actual := try quantity(trailing[3])
            quantities = [supplied, actual]
        elif command == "DELTAH"
            for item := species[]
                match heats.get(item.name)
                    int value
                        enthalpies = enthalpies.append(value)
                    none
                        return error("no enthalpy for " + item.name)
        if redox
            for item := species[]
                if locate(["H^+", "OH^-", "H2O"], item.core) >= 0
                    return error("reserved species " + item.name)
            ion := try read_species(if args[0] == "acidic" then "H^+" else "OH^-")
            water := try read_species("H2O")
            species = species.append(ion).append(water)
            signs = signs.append(1).append(1)
            if command == "HALF"
                species = species.append(Species("e^-", "e^-", "", Formula(array(54, fill = 0), -1)))
                signs = signs.append(1)
        matrix := analyze(species, signs)
        if command == "MATRIX"
            output := ["columns: " + [for item := species[] then item.name].join(" ")]
            for: i < #matrix.labels
                output = output.append(matrix.labels[i] + ": " + [for value := matrix.entries[i][] then string(value)].join(" "))
            output = output.append("rank {matrix.rank}, nullity {#matrix.basis}")
            for vector := matrix.basis[]
                output = output.append("null: " + [for value := vector[] then string(value)].join(" "))
            return output
        if command == "CHECK"
            string[] differences := []
            for: i < #matrix.labels
                left := 0
                right := 0
                for: j < #species
                    if int(j) < equation.reactants
                        left += matrix.entries[i][j] * species[j].coefficient
                    else
                        right -= matrix.entries[i][j] * species[j].coefficient
                if left != right
                    charge_row := matrix.labels[i] == "charge"
                    differences = differences.append(matrix.labels[i] + ": " + (if charge_row then signed(left) else string(left)) + " != " + (if charge_row then signed(right) else string(right)))
            if #differences > 0
                return ["not balanced"].concat(differences)
            divisor := 0
            for item := species[]
                divisor = gcd(divisor, item.coefficient)
            return [if divisor == 1 then "balanced" else "balanced, not in lowest terms (gcd {divisor})"]
        int[] coefficients := []
        match determine(matrix, #equation.species)
            string failure
                return [failure]
            int[] found
                coefficients = found
        if redox
            string[] left := []
            string[] right := []
            for: i < #species
                coefficient := coefficients[i]
                if coefficient == 0
                    continue
                reactant := if i < #equation.species then int(i) < equation.reactants else coefficient > 0
                text := term(species[i].name, absolute(coefficient))
                if reactant
                    left = left.append(text)
                else
                    right = right.append(text)
            output := [left.join(" + ") + " -> " + right.join(" + ")]
            if command == "HALF"
                electrons := coefficients[-1]
                output = output.append(if electrons > 0 then "reduction" elif electrons < 0 then "oxidation" else "no electron transfer")
            return output
        output := [balanced(equation, coefficients)]
        if command == "STOICH"
            denominator := coefficients[first] * species[first].formula.mass()
            for: i < #species
                scaled := quantities[0] * coefficients[i]
                line := species[i].name + " " + decimal(scaled * 1000000 / denominator, 6) + " mol " + decimal(scaled * species[i].formula.mass() / denominator, 3) + " g"
                if species[i].state == "(g)"
                    line += " " + decimal(scaled * 22414 / denominator, 3) + " L"
                output = output.append(line)
        elif command == "LIMITING"
            limiting := 0
            for: i < equation.reactants
                if quantities[i] * coefficients[limiting] * species[limiting].formula.mass() < quantities[limiting] * coefficients[i] * species[i].formula.mass()
                    limiting = i
            denominator := coefficients[limiting] * species[limiting].formula.mass()
            supplied := quantities[limiting]
            output = output.append("limiting " + species[limiting].name).append("extent " + decimal(supplied * 1000000 / denominator, 6) + " mol")
            for: equation.reactants <= i < int(#species)
                scaled := supplied * coefficients[i]
                line := "product " + species[i].name + " " + decimal(scaled * species[i].formula.mass() / denominator, 3) + " g"
                if species[i].state == "(g)"
                    line += " " + decimal(scaled * 22414 / denominator, 3) + " L"
                output = output.append(line)
            for: i < equation.reactants
                if i != limiting
                    output = output.append("remaining " + species[i].name + " " + decimal((quantities[i] * denominator - supplied * coefficients[i] * species[i].formula.mass()) / denominator, 3) + " g")
        elif command == "YIELD"
            theoretical := quantities[0] * coefficients[second] * species[second].formula.mass() / (coefficients[first] * species[first].formula.mass())
            output = output.append("theoretical " + decimal(theoretical, 3) + " g").append("actual " + decimal(quantities[1], 3) + " g")
            output = output.append(if theoretical == 0 then "yield undefined" else "yield " + decimal(quantities[1] * 10000 / theoretical, 2) + "%")
        elif command == "DELTAH"
            change := 0
            for: i < #species
                change -= signs[i] * coefficients[i] * enthalpies[i]
            kind := if change < 0 then "exothermic" elif change > 0 then "endothermic" else "thermoneutral"
            output = output.append("dH = " + decimal(change, 2) + " kJ ({kind})")
        return output

void run_commands()
    calculator := Calculator()
    nat count := 0
    scan(&count)
    for: i < count
        line := ""
        scan(&line)
        match .calculator.execute(line.split(" "))
            string[] output
                for item := output[]
                    emit(item)
            error failure
                emit("error: " + failure.message)

run_commands()
